name.value: The Sportsbar LIVE! At Rogers Arena

description.value: The Sportsbar is a 14,000-square-foot, 420-seat sports bar and full-service restaurant on the 3rd level of Rogers Arena, home of the Vancouver Canucks. It is accessible directly from outside the arena without a game ticket via the Georgia Viaduct entrance, making it a standalone dining destination in downtown Vancouver. The venue features over 100 4K HDTVs, a 90-foot illuminated bar, 60+ draft taps, and a menu from Executive Chef Robert Bartley built on fresh and local ingredients.
